member.name: T:InfGame.BigDouble
member.summary: A struct to handle massive numbers for incremental games. Stores value as Mantissa * 10^Exponent. Precision is ~15 digits (standard double). Range is effectively infinite.

member.name: M:InfGame.BigDouble.Normalize
member.summary: Keeps Mantissa between [1, 10) or [-10, -1] to maintain precision.

member.name: M:InfGame.BigDouble.Pow(InfGame.BigDouble,System.Double)
member.summary: Calculates Base^Exponent. Essential for Cost Scaling: BaseCost * Growth^Count

member.name: T:InfGame.GeneratorDef
member.summary: Static data defining a type of generator (e.g., "Cursor", "Farm", "Mine").

member.name: T:InfGame.Resource
